title: Atlas local runtime qualified retrieval across registered source and derived evidence
uncertainty: Can one usable pinned runtime query workflow retrieve the registered native population and accepted derived scalar evidence by explicit support, identity and honest temporal/knowledge qualification without conflating native support, sampled quantity or observation time?
importance: Accountable onboarding and revisions now work, but native spatial/feature/year queries and the32 derived quantities still have separate lookup interfaces; derived selection is identity/property only. That demonstrated usability gap limits asking qualified physical-world questions through the runtime.
prerequisites: accepted registration/lifecycle runtime and unchanged Tryfan/Riffelhorn retained inputs
accepted native retrieval, derived method/support and temporal contracts
canonical authority, full validation and disposable SQLite boundaries
scope: one documented runtime library/CLI qualified retrieval interface over the existing49 native selectors and32 derived results
source/derived identity, region, representation and explicit geographic support semantics; candidate selection followed by exact qualification checks
native known/unknown year qualifications and separate immutable registration knowledge revision/publication pin inspection
honest distinction between native raster/vector support, consumed stencil footprint and a local derived quantity; no source fusion or physical change inference
bounded catalogue adapter only if required; no new dataset/method, arbitrary query engine, production app or service
deliverable: A usable qualified source/derived retrieval vertical slice with documented predicates, independent full-scan oracle, pinned historical and failure tests, measurements and protections.
acceptance: exact identities/provenance/rights/time/support match accepted native and scalar oracles
spatial/identity/qualification predicates cannot silently change scientific meaning
unknown observation time remains explicitly unknown
registration knowledge revisions and publication pins remain distinct from physical time
current and historical queries replay after restart and catalogue rebuild
missing/staged/incompatible state fails explicitly without fallback or mutation
accepted evidence/contracts/42 statuses/113 production hashes and regressions unchanged
stop: Stop after that one bounded retrieval workflow is implemented, measured, tested, documented, committed and pushed. Do not begin regional preparation, new derivations, ingestion platform or public/cloud service.
